'''Noggox''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] independent of the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Grand Council]] who [[Noggox's fortress|resided]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Affa/Legends|Affa]]. Noggox and his retinue were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Stop! I have money! I can--!|Noggox trying to negotiate prior to his death|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Opress Unleashed">{{StoryCite|story=Opress Unleashed|book=Free Comic Book Day 2011 Special}}</ref>}}
[[File:MissiontoAffa.jpg|right|thumb|200px|Savage Opress, Noggox killer]]
Noggox was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], and his skin was [[Color/Legends|tan]] with purple [[Limb/Legends|arms]], and yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. He operated a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] industrial factory on Affa independent of the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt authorities]], and had state of the art defenses, and ensured his guards were loyal and dangerous.<ref name="Strange Allies" /> In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Noggox sold [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brains]] to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. One of his [[Unidentified Consular-class cruiser (Noggox)|freighters]] was intercepted by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Dool Pundar]], although the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] had been insured and Noggox had instructed the [[Unidentified Klatooinian captain|captain]] what to do in such a situation. A distress call was routed to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the Republics [[Capital/Legends|capital]], and [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] agreed to provide escorts for the remaining shipment. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Nuru Kungurama]] was sent, along with his [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Breakout Squad|squad]]. Before the Jedi could arrive, Noggox's guards found an intruder at the fortress. The intruder, the [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]], warned Noggox was in danger because [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]],<ref name="Strange Allies" /> the leader of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="SWE2">{{Film|II}}</ref> knew that Noggox was dealing with the Jedi. Opress then proceeded to slaughter Noggox and his entire staff, although Noggox tried to negotiate with the Acolyte. When Kungurama arrived, he and his squad found the remains of the massacre when they arrived, but continued their mission by taking the freighter to [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]]. Republic investigators later concluded that the massacre had been perpetrated by a lone [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]].<ref name="Strange Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
Noggox first appeared in [[Opress Unleashed|''The Clone Wars: Opress Unleashed'']], a [[2011]] comic released as a promotion on [[Free Comic Book Day]]. The comic was then included in ''[[The Clone Wars: Strange Allies]]'', a tie-in to the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Secret Missions]]'' young readers series, which was released later that year.
